newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson says wins 750 mln Skr Thai order.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says wins 750 mln Skr Thai order.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Friday it won an order worth more than 750 million crowns from Thai mobile phone operator Advanced Info Service (AIS), a unit of the Shinawatra Group.
Ericsson will further expand two mobile phone networks, one Nordic Mobile Telephone (NMT) 900 and one global system for mobile telecommunications (GSM), the company said in a statement.
The order concerns switching and radio base station equipment. The main part of deliveries and installations are expected to take place in 1997.
